subject: Post-discovery: Private hosting design review & demo
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@wellpointhealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@wellpointhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: Private hosting design review & demo

Hi Samantha & Rajiv,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

- Goal: run a focused technical deep dive to validate network/firewall constraints, deployment topology (VPC vs on-prem), and operational runbook needs.
- Suggested owners: Connor O'Brien (solutions engineer) will lead the technical walkthrough; Marissa will cover procurement/ops questions.
- Proposed slots (PT): Wed May 12 9:00–10:00am, Thu May 13 10:00–11:00am or Fri May 14 1:00–2:00pm — happy to add other times.
- Agenda (30–60m): current infra review, security & key management (KMS/HSM), data flow and residency, integration points, open action items & next steps.

Could you confirm which slot works and who from your infra/security team should join? Also please send any existing network diagrams or port lists in advance — Connor will use them to prepare a runbook draft.

Attaching a one-page discovery summary we took during the call.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (1 page)

From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@wellpointhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@wellpointhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Private hosting design review & demo

Thanks, Jordan.

Thu May 13 10:00–11:00am PT works best for our infra lead (Rajiv) and me. We'll also include Lina Gomez (security architect) — she's out of office Tue/Wed but available Thu.

Can your team share any pre-call checklist or example network diagram templates? We'll also need to review SOC 2 / encryption-at-rest details before the call.

I attached a short sampling of our current network boundary diagram (internal-use). If you need additional docs, let me know.

Best,
Samantha

Attachments: wellpoint-network-sample.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@wellpointhealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@wellpointhealth.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@wellpointhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Private hosting design review & demo

Perfect — locking Thu May 13 10:00am PT.

Connor will lead and will circulate a 1-page pre-call checklist and a short runbook template by EOD tomorrow. In the meantime, I'm attaching our Redwood private hosting brief and the prep checklist (draft). Key asks for your team before the call:

- Confirm attendee list (Rajiv/Lina + any network engineers)
- Share any current firewall rules / egress policies and a high-level inventory of key vault/KMS usage
- Any compliance evidence we should review (SOC/ISO) — we can provide our SOC 2 summary as well.

I'll send a calendar invite with conference details and a shared Drive folder for artifacts.

Jordan

Attachments: redwood-priv-hosting-brief.pdf, precall-checklist.xlsx

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@wellpointhealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@wellpointhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Private hosting design review & demo — prep & quick ask

Hi all — quick prep from my side ahead of Thu's call.

On the call I'll walk through an example VPC architecture and an on-prem alternative, and I'll highlight port ranges, outbound IPs for egress, and HSM/KMS integration patterns. If you can drop the following into the shared Drive before Wed EOD it will save time:

- High-level CIDR ranges and any NAT/firewall devices
- A list of IPs allowed for outbound third-party services
- Existing key management provider (if not using AWS KMS)

On Thu we'll aim to identify the minimal access footprint required for a Proof of Concept; that will drive our runbook and quote.

Thanks — Connor
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
